source.description: 한국마사회 공공데이터 기반 기존 프로젝트 산출물

integrity_notes: Raw data is immutable; downstream pipelines must never modify this file.
Eight races contain multiple winner rows, consistent with possible dead heats.
Two races contain no winner row and require whole-race rejection or resolution downstream.
Registration-number and compound-key columns must be loaded as strings.
Most Seoul hrNo values are stored as five characters in the raw CSV; the canonical loader restores the documented seven-character format with leading zeroes.
